answer: The inlet lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the beacon is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, clawed back after a replayed submission, no identity may audit its own recruit. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the forge of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
